goal: Measure the corrected post-receipt host-path candidate exactly once against the sealed strict-pointer-decode result. Preserve the accepted paired outer scope, every phase boundary, exhaustive assignment coverage, strict output validation, canonical digest, fixture, lane points, trials, and native worker count; bank the result whether it improves, regresses, fails, or is unchanged.

baseline.status: Sealed and preserved; this is the sole immediate before measurement.

changesFromSealedDecodePointerSource.name: flat lane-major decoded storage
changesFromSealedDecodePointerSource.description: Replace nested per-lane decoded arrays with one UInt32 array of lanes times output-wire count. collectOutputs still strictly decodes and stores every lane/output value at lane * wireCount + output column, and digest traverses lane then canonical output-wire order over the same values.
changesFromSealedDecodePointerSource.workRemoved: Per-lane inner-array allocation and pointer chasing only.

changesFromSealedDecodePointerSource.name: precomputed immutable input metadata
changesFromSealedDecodePointerSource.description: Precompute each input buffer's bit position, using a sentinel for clk, and traverse assignmentMasks through unsafe buffer views. The assignment(lane:lanes:inputBits:) formula is unchanged, and every timed pass still rewrites all 17 input buffers including clk=0 for every lane and coefficient.

changesFromSealedDecodePointerSource.name: precomputed immutable output metadata
changesFromSealedDecodePointerSource.description: Precompute each output buffer's canonical column and traverse one flat destination buffer. Output-buffer reads, output order [24,25,26,27,28,29,30,31,23], strict decode, and full value materialization are unchanged.

timedPointerBinding.input: MTLBuffer.contents().bindMemory remains inside refillInputs after the assignment timestamp and therefore inside timed input pack.
timedPointerBinding.output: MTLBuffer.contents().bindMemory remains inside collectOutputs and therefore inside timed strict decode.

excludedInvalidReporting.reason: NATIVE_EVAL was removed because subtracting independent HELUT medians and comparing unequal work scopes would not be a valid paired metric.

preExecutionCheck.rule: Immediately before execution, recompute source and compiled-XCTest SHA-256 plus mtimes. Execute only if both hashes exactly equal the freeze values and the source still contains no NATIVE_EVAL or prebound input/output pointers. Record the observed values in the receipt.

timingAndCorrectnessContract.pairedHELUT: Assignment-mask regeneration and writes to every preallocated input buffer, including input pointer binding, through synchronized graph execution, output pointer binding, strict output traversal/decode into complete flat lane-major values, and canonical ordered FNV-1a digest.
timingAndCorrectnessContract.digestOrder: lane-major, then output order [24,25,26,27,28,29,30,31,23], hashing little-endian UInt32 lane, wire, and decoded value

primary: B=65536 HELUT paired-total median versus sealed decode-pointer HELUT median
B=65536 HELUT paired-total median versus contemporaneous native parallel median
whether any paired crossover occurs through B=65536
reporting.phaseDiagnosis: Compare all B=65536 phase medians and the median-total trial. Because native pays the same canonical digest, identify the remaining differential from HELUT assignment plus input pack plus graph plus decode versus native prepared assign/eval/collect rather than presenting digest removal as a crossover.
secondary: all eight HELUT and native medians
comparison with the original 32.414079 ms decomposed HELUT baseline
reporting.ratioDirection: baseline median divided by candidate median; greater than 1 means lower candidate time
reporting.medianCaveat: Independent phase medians are not summed. Percentages use the candidate median-total trial.
reporting.noSignificanceClaim: Five unpinned samples support descriptive ratios only, not a statistical generalization.

failurePolicy: Execute the exact preregistered command once and preserve any failure, partial output, unfavorable result, or regression. Do not silently rerun, select a favorable sample set, lower B/trials/workers, move timing boundaries, prebind MTL pointers outside their phases, weaken strict decoding, alter the digest, erase prior evidence, or replace the sealed baseline.
claimBoundary: One corrected source-level host-path candidate in one release-Swift/MPSGraph combinational benchmark on one unpinned Mac16,5. It is not a general Swift, Metal, Apple, HDL, or native-superiority claim.
